Deliverable 2: Aligned tech stack, architecture, and spec
Starting in November, the new Catalyst team held a series of discussions to assess the state of the previous Hydra Auction proof-of-concept project and determine its suitability to be adapted to the new production and mainnet-ready hydra-based auction protocol that we are targeting in this project.
We identified the following major changes that would be needed to align the tech stack, architecture, and specifications between MLabs and Ikigai to achieve the goals of the project:
・Announce auctions and hydra head delegate groups with metadata records posted on-chain as utxo datums held in unparametrized validator addresses, so that anyone would be able to discover all auctions and all hydra head delegate groups servicing auctions via simple blockchain queries without relying on any off-chain information. Furthermore, the metadata record of an auction should contain all the parametrized validator scripts and currency symbols used to manage that auction’s state, so that a person who finds the auction can follow along and discover its full current state. This will improve the robustness of the auction protocol (one less single-point-of-failure) and make it more decentralized. Previously, discoverability in the proof-of-concept was managed via a centralized off-chain service that would let all the sellers, bidders, and hydra head delegates know about each other and about where to find auction state. See https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/hydra-auction/blob/staging/docs/on_chain_spec.md#announcements-discoverability-and-state
・Rework the mechanism by which an auction’s standing bid is moved to Layer 2 (L2) for bidding,

MILESTONE EVIDENCE
During Milestone 3 we introduced Hydra into the project and effectively implemented L2 auctions. The evidence of this milestone is as follows:
1) The main output of this milestone is integrated basic backend and cloud systems for Hydra auctions in the form of a delegate server, that delegates run to automate spawn Hydra nodes and coordinate with each other (all PRs mentioned will be merged into https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/hydra-auction-offchain by the time of submission).
・The main PR https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/hydra-auction-offchain/pull/31
・L2 auctions happy-path is covered with tests based on Hydra off-line mode developed by SandaeSwap in Catalyst Fund10 https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/hydra-auction-offchain/pull/33
・A separate server with WebSocket support to broadcast L2 auctions was implemented https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/hydra-auction-offchain/pull/35
・New endpoints for L2 auction support were added https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/hydra-auction-offchain/pull/36

2) The video demonstrating the integrated architecture and the enhanced smart contracts at a high level is available here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Msu96EmfaRs
3) The specification for additional auction features (namely open auctions and full-backed bids) can be found here https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/hydra-auction-offchain/blob/staging/docs/future_improvements.md

ms.report:
As was duly noted, the amount of documentation for Hydra SDK was too low. This [PR](https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/purescript-hydra-sdk/pull/4) fixes that.
* The README.md contains a section `Getting Started with Example` that gives step-by-step instruction on running the example. 
* All Purescript modules that constitute SDK have been thoroughly commented. You can either read the docs in the source code or alternatively you can generate it as described in the README.md (see `Development Workflows` section).

NB. The PR mentioned depends on the minimal example, which is a part of the next, Final milestone. Though it's almost ready, we haven't finalize that work. It was very inconvenient to work on the docs separately, so we decided to address reviewers' comments in a PR based on the future work, which is not yet ready to merge. This is why we cannot close the PR right now, but we will do it as soon as we are done with PR#3. We hope it won't prevent this part from being considered completed.
